review_notes: [v2] References [6]-[23] (single column, entries in printed order, no interleaving). Printed oddities kept: [7] 'Ashish Vaswani. Attention is all you need.', [15] 'Llms trained on" a is b" fail to learn" b is a".' (straight quotes and spacing as printed, checked in a 260-dpi crop), [12] entry without a year, [8] '222(594-604):309–368'. Check OK, 48/48 lines. Page number omitted.
